versions.content: Handling if EthTrcv_MacSecAddRxSa is called and EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecAddRxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthTrcvConfig identified with the given TrcvIdx • a reception secure association can be added to the given association number (see An ), i.e. the given association number is not occupied then the EthTrcv driver shall perform the following actions. Otherwise return with E_ NOT_OK : • create a reception secure association at the PHY that corresponds to the given TrcvIdx by considering the given association number (see An ), the lowest ac- ceptable packet number (see LowestPn ), the short secure channel identifier (see Ssci ) and the secured association key (available via KeysPtr and addressed with SakKeyPtr ) • activate the created reception secure association, if given API parameter Active is set to TRUE , otherwise deactivate reception secure association • return with E_OK .
